state_change_proposals: The 306th evening: the young one buried under stone at the pass's EAST mouth by his crew (the six carried at Teague's leave: 'Carry, if you're carrying'); nobody said the name; Oryn three strides off, kit closed. The MULE and boxes recovered by Lira and Seln via the ridge path by dusk. Count: eleven and a mule.

Camp on the plain's edge below the east mouth; the site a half-day east in the haze. ORYN on the ribs: 'That's a line. That's not yours.' / 'It's mine now.' / 'Then it costs what his costs.' — the line stops in the ribs every time; no term set tonight ('tomorrow's a site'); she will not read him again till he has stood where he is going. Karis writing with the bound hand ('Yes'). Vastin day 27, on the ground. Teague one short, not saying the number.

THE INWARD READING (deliberate; the twelfth): still → set → BONES; 'a floor with nothing built on it'; 'an instruction with no language'; rows that lean with the floors' lean; 'the same kind of thing, to that instrument, as the sites were to Cleon's' (the only finding entered). Cost: the eyes, an hour. He told NO ONE (Lira 'first with this too, one day'; Oryn's finding is hers; Karis would have made a third page). Cleon's warning kept.
ARBITER: dark since the kindling at fourteen; unchanged; dated.

INSTRUMENTS (Book-11 plant 3): the cord — twenty strides / nineteen and a piece / nineteen and a piece (a whole stride short; a piece at Lowmarch); the Ternhall edge misses the fourth and fifth circles by a hair and a half to two (a hair at Lowmarch); Hesk's edge longer than on the landing. TREND: UP. Unsourced. The two facts placed side by side ('the instruments read wronger; the oldest one is a half-day east') and no line drawn.
Close: the fixed LOG ('the whole year'). Cash 123. Next: Ch23 dialogue (the threshold).
